items.title: Bayer banks €3bn in Apollo contraceptives division deal
items.summary: Bayer's agreement with Apollo comes a little after Bayer broke its pharma dealmaking fast by acquiring Perfuse Therapeutics in May 2026.

items.title: Chinese biotech MindRank secures $52m to advance AI-designed oral GLP-1RA
items.summary: The funds will support the progression of MindRank’s pipeline, which is heavily dominated by obesity indications.

items.title: Ipsen set to rival Botox after duo of Phase III migraine wins
items.summary: Ipsen claims that Dysport has become the first botulinum toxin therapy to demonstrate efficacy in episodic migraine.

items.title: Teva and Polpharma Biologics sign global deal for ocrelizumab biosimilar
items.summary: Teva Pharmaceuticals International and Polpharma Biologics have signed a global licensing agreement for a proposed biosimilar to Ocrevus to treat multiple sclerosis.

items.title: Apertura and NIH institutes to test gene therapy for NPC1
items.summary: Apertura has entered a CRADA with various NIH institutes for a gene therapy to treat Niemann-Pick Disease Type C1 (NPC1).
